description: OECD AI Paper No. 59 — the 9 AI capability domains mapped against occupational requirements (language, social interaction, problem solving, creativity, metacognition/critical thinking, knowledge/learning/memory, vision, manipulation, robotic intelligence). Creativity is the direct entry-point for Atana cultural analysis. Caveat: OECD's creativity scale level 5 (exceptional/world-class) is rarely required of whole occupations and compresses the active range — small measured creativity gap is partly artifactual.
notes: Domain definitions from the OECD AI Capability Indicators framework. atana_relevance column carries the cultural-occupation entry-point for each domain.
